eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Crook, WY; at 2:36 PM on AUG 2, 2026 Effective until 6:36 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Crook County Alert: A SET evacuation status is being put into place for all residents from the Devil's Tower junction (Hwy 110 and Hwy 24) South to the Junction of Hwy 24 and Hwy 14. Be prepared to evacuate. A wild fire is moving fast and not controlled. BE READY TO EVACUATE
